themes.title: Far-right parties exploit migration crises for political gain
themes.blurb: Right-wing and far-right parties across Europe are leveraging migration crises to bolster their political agendas. In Spain, Vox is pushing for legal action against the government over the Ceuta migration crisis, while Italy's Fratelli d'Italia and Lega are clashing with Spain over border controls. Germany's AfD is also capitalizing on migration tensions ahead of regional elections.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Demands legal action against Spain's government over Ceuta migration crisis, framing it as a national security issue.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Clashes with Spain over border controls and migration policies, suspending Schengen rules.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: Uses migration tensions to gain support ahead of regional elections, proposing strict deportation policies.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Criticizes UK government's handling of Channel crossings, proposing military solutions.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Opposes EU migration policies, calling for stricter border controls and national sovereignty.

countries.note: Proposes restricting local election voting rights to Norwegian citizens, citing security concerns.

themes.title: Right-wing leaders rally behind restrictive birthright citizenship policies
themes.blurb: The U.S. and Hungary are leading a transnational push for restrictive birthright citizenship policies. Trump's administration is attempting to narrow birthright citizenship exceptions, while Hungary's Fidesz and Tisza parties are debating constitutional reforms that could impact citizenship rights. Poland's PiS is also exploring similar policies as part of its nationalist agenda.

themes.title: Right-wing governments target social programs amid fiscal debates
themes.blurb: Right-wing governments in the U.S., Argentina, and Hungary are targeting social programs as part of broader fiscal debates. Trump's administration is cutting funding for homelessness programs and Head Start, while Javier Milei's government in Argentina is reducing public sector employment and privatizing state assets. Hungary's Tisza party is also debating cuts to social spending as part of its economic reform agenda.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Proposes deregulating Head Start program and cutting homelessness funding, shifting resources to mining and defense.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Reducing public sector employment and privatizing state assets as part of fiscal austerity measures.

countries.name: 🇭🇺 Fidesz / Tisza
countries.note: Debating cuts to social spending and energy subsidies as part of economic reforms, while increasing defense and infrastructure spending.

themes.title: AfD surge reshapes German politics ahead of regional elections

themes.title: Right-wing leaders face internal divisions and leadership challenges
themes.blurb: Right-wing parties across multiple countries are grappling with internal divisions and leadership challenges. Poland's PiS is facing a split with former Prime Minister Morawiecki forming a new faction, while Italy's Lega is dealing with dissent over its alliance with Fratelli d'Italia. Argentina's La Libertad Avanza is also experiencing internal conflicts between different factions of the Milei government.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Dealing with dissent over alliance strategies and leadership decisions, particularly regarding Vannacci's defection.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Experiencing internal conflicts between Karina Milei and other government factions over policy direction.
